title: Counit-normalized mate calculation for the integral residue pull comparison
statement: For every scheme map f and homotopy-category object H of integral coefficient modules, after composing the flat-model comparison composite with the inverse residue pullback counit, the result equals the residue pull mate followed by residue pullback of the integral reduction counit.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15; derived mate comparison after the flatness clause

proof.text: Use the shared scalar mate/counit identity at H. Postcompose with the inverse residue pullback counit supplied by hC; associativity and hom_inv_id cancel that counit.

proof_origin.place: Remark 6.8.15; derived mate comparison after the flatness clause

The original helper copies are removed from ScalarCounitModel, which imports the two shared entry points.

theorem residueExchangePull_flatModel_mate_normalized
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (H : HomotopyCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) (.up ℤ))
    (hC : IsIso ((residueExchangeUpperStarCounit
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).app
      (((Mod.extendScalars
        (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) Y)).mapHomotopyCategory
          (.up ℤ)).obj H))) :
    ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X).map
        ((residueExchangeUpperStarCounit (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).app H) ≫
      (residueExchangeReductionCounit ℓ E X).app
        ((((f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj H) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
          (pullIso (integralReductionMap ℓ E) f).hom (.up ℤ)).app H)) ≫
      inv ((residueExchangeUpperStarCounit
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).app
        (((Mod.extendScalars
          (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) Y)).mapHomotopyCategory
            (.up ℤ)).obj H)) =
    (residueExchangePullHom ℓ E f).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj H) ≫
      (residueExchangeUpperStar
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).map
        ((residueExchangeReductionCounit ℓ E Y).app H)
